profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Zip Co
profile.summary: I am a software engineer who wants people to succeed by building the missing tools to accomplish their goals. With my background in investing and financial planning, I strive to turn general ideas into successful products by working with others to shape an achievable goal. I am excited to be a contributing force for the next generation of apps to help others define their legacy.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Software Engineering Immersive (SEI) Associate Instructor, Austin TX
positions.description:
As Austin's Software Engineering Immersive instructor, I assist in teaching full stack technologies to the next generation of software engineers in an intensive 12-week program. 

• Front-end web development: HTML, CSS, SASS, JavaScript, jQuery, React.js, React Native
• Back-end technologies: Node.js, Express, Python, Django 
• Database management: PostgreSQL, NoSQL with mongoDB, Firebase

positions.title: Software Engineer Fellow
positions.description:
Three-month, 500-hour full-time and full-stack software engineering program conducted in a classroom, providing experience with the latest front-end and back-end programming languages, tools, and methodologies including: HTML, CSS, Javascript, jQuery, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AngularJS, NodeJS, ReactJS, Wordpress, Git, Github, and Agile/Scrum.

Developing a portfolio of individual and collaboratively focused in-class project, including:
• Lemonade Game 
• Memory Game
• Fantasy Portfolio

positions.title: Financial Advisor
positions.description:
• Responsible for providing investment advice based on clients personal situation
• Conducted financial reviews to see what was suitable and where we could improve before investing in the markets
• Worked with internal sales desk to create custom portfolios in all sectors of the market including bonds, stocks, mutual funds, ETFs, structured products, options and other derivatives
• Created hypothetical portfolios before implementing and back-tested them to show what it would have done based on previous markets
• Conducted sales training seminars to help the incoming financial advisors get adjusted to the team
• Worked with new and existing clients 
• Completed CRPC trainings and attained designation
